summary: Frontend testing of Althea AI multi-user chat (iteration 23). All 10 requested flows passed on desktop (1920x900) and mobile (390x844): unauth redirect, wrong-password error, founder login, register-signout, DM with Ada (zero-LLM math 2^8-6=250, conversion 12mi=19.3121km, @althea mention 9*9=81), two-user realtime (both directions saw messages within ~1.5s), dm-back-btn restores private chat-console + comms-panel, private Althea terminal (/vectors prints SELF-ASSESSMENT AEE/2.0, /help works, 17*23=391 tagged EVO-V2/zero-LLM), evolution tab renders evolution-screen+evolution-vector-board, mobile switcher shows althea/lattice/people and switches to Ada/lattice/althea when DM opened, no horizontal overflow on mobile, Google button present (not clicked), all removed UI confirmed absent (no download/purge/telemetry/command-bar/browser/observe/satellite/quantum/troubleshoot/research testids).

issues: React hydration warning: <span> inside <option> element (console error from dev-only x-component instrumentation wrapping option contents). Non-blocking but should be verified not caused by production code.
